name: PCBs & controls
description: Control boards and electronic parts for AC units.
long_description: Modern ACs depend on control boards to manage sensors, timers, inverter drives and safety cut-outs. Voltage fluctuations and moisture are common causes of failure. We help source model-specific PCBs, sensors and display boards, and Subzero digital temperature controllers for refrigeration.
match_by: Brand, model number and board part code

parts.name: Indoor & outdoor unit PCBs
parts.detail: Main control boards for indoor and outdoor units.
parts.summary: The control PCB reads the sensors and remote, and switches the compressor, fans and swing motor. We source model-specific original boards, and universal boards for many fixed-speed split ACs.
specs: Indoor main boards, outdoor control boards, power boards
Original (OEM) boards, or universal kits with remote and sensors
Brand, model number and the part code printed on the board
Sensors, display, swing motor, fan motor, compressor relay
notes: Send a clear photo of the board and its part code
Protect the new board with a voltage stabiliser where supply is unstable

parts.name: Inverter drive boards
parts.detail: Compressor drive boards for inverter ACs.
parts.summary: The inverter drive board turns the mains supply into a DC bus, then into a variable-frequency three-phase output for the compressor (and often the fan). It is the heart of an inverter outdoor unit.
specs: Rectifier, PFC and inverter stage for the compressor
IPM (intelligent power module) on a heat sink
Three-phase drive to the BLDC compressor; DC fan drive on many models
Brand, outdoor model and board part code
notes: Read the fault code first: compressor, sensor and supply faults can look like board faults
Large capacitors hold a charge: let the board discharge before handling

parts.name: Temperature & coil sensors
parts.summary: NTC thermistor sensors measure room, indoor coil, outdoor coil and discharge temperatures. A faulty sensor gives wrong readings, error codes or poor control.
specs: NTC thermistor in an epoxy or copper probe
Common values 5, 10, 15, 20 and 50 kΩ (discharge sensors often 50 kΩ)
Room air, indoor coil, outdoor coil, discharge pipe
Twin-core lead, usually with a 2-pin plug
Measure resistance with a multimeter and compare with the maker's chart
notes: Match resistance value, probe type and plug, not just the cable length

parts.name: Display panels & receivers
parts.detail: Display boards and remote signal receivers.
parts.summary: The display board shows temperature and status, and its infrared receiver picks up the remote's signal. If the unit stops responding to the remote, the receiver is a common culprit.
specs: Infrared receiver module, typically 38 kHz carrier
LED digits and indicator lights, per model
Ribbon cable or multi-pin lead to the main PCB
Unit model and part code on the board
notes: Check the remote's batteries and test it with a phone camera before changing the receiver

parts.name: Subzero digital controllers
parts.detail: Digital temperature controllers for cold rooms, chillers and refrigerated counters.
parts.summary: Subzero digital temperature controllers switch the compressor, defrost and fans to hold a set temperature. They are widely used in cold rooms, chillers, visi-coolers and display counters.
specs: Digital temperature controller with LED display
NTC or PTC probe, supplied with the controller
Relay outputs for compressor; defrost and fan on multi-output models
230 V AC on most models; low-voltage versions available
Set point, differential, defrost timing and alarms, depending on model
notes: Share the model number on the old controller, or the outputs you need
Use a contactor if the compressor current is above the relay rating

signs: Error code or blinking lights on the display
Unit does not respond to the remote
